title: Her boots on the ramp
logline: A pair of city boots on Gully's ramp, mud on the soles from the flats, and the page's edge: a hem, a hand with a can. The strip's Chloe at forty-four arrives as boots.

panels.composition: A pair of city boots on a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with fresh mud on the soles, a hem and a hand holding a can of beer at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a pair of city boots on a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with fresh mud on the soles and a hem and a hand holding a beer can at the frame's edge, no words legible
